product_summary: D2C South-Indian food brand (sweetkaramcoffee.in). Real catalogue lines: (1) filter coffee powder 80:20 and instant filter coffee decoction — coffee, roasted/chicory blends; (2) milk mixes / hot chocolate mixes (ABC apple-beetroot-carrot milk mix, ragi hot chocolate) — malt/milk-based food preparations; (3) sweets: Mysore pak, coconut burfi, athirasam, ragi laddu, jaggery coconut burfi — sugar confectionery; (4) chikkis & chikki bars (peanut, sesame) — sugar confectionery with nuts; (5) snacks: murukku/ribbon pakoda, Madras mixture, Andhra spicy mixture, banana chips, tapioca (kappa) chips, potato/papad chips — fried/extruded savoury snacks; (6) papads & fryums (rice appalam, urad dal papad, jeera papad, javvarisi vadam, creamy onion papad); (7) pickles (cut mango, Andhra avakkai) and rice-mix pastes (tomato/lemon/puliyogare) — preserved vegetables / prepared foods; (8) masalas & ghee (sambar powder, Andhra dal powder, ghee); (9) non-food merchandise: brass coffee filter, brass davara & tumbler, brass spice box, jute bags, gift hampers, e-gift cards.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — brand/own-label manufacturer (own recipes, 'Janaki Paati's Store', no-palm-oil claims) but also resells non-food merchandise (brassware, jute bags, gift cards) and gift hampers, which are pure trading items.
comment: Declared HS 210111 (coffee extracts/essences/concentrates) is only PARTIALLY correct. It fits the instant filter coffee decoction (coffee extract-based preparation) but NOT the core range: roasted filter coffee powder is 0901.21 (roasted coffee, not decaffeinated) — a different chapter entirely; milk/hot-chocolate mixes are 1806.90/1901.90/2106.90; sweets, burfi, athirasam, laddu and chikkis are 1704.90/2008.11/2006.00; murukku, mixture and chips are 1905.90/1904.10/2005.99/2005.20; papads and fryums are 1905.90; pickles 2001.90; rice-mix pastes 2106.90/2001.90; sambar and dal powders 2103.90/0910; ghee 0405.90. So the declaration covers a minor SKU family while the bulk of turnover (snacks, sweets, chikkis, papads, pickles, coffee powder) sits in 0901, 1704, 1905, 2005, 2008, 2001. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right, but the HS line is too narrow — recommend correcting to a multi-code list led by 0901.21 (filter coffee powder) and 2101.11 (instant decoction), plus 1704.90, 1905.90, 2005.99, 2008.11, 2001.90, 2103.90. Trader signs: brass coffee filters, davara/tumbler sets, spice boxes, jute bags, e-gift cards and curated hampers are clearly bought-in/resold goods and are absent from the declaration; if these are exported they need their own codes (7418.10/7323.94 for brassware, 6305.33 for jute bags). Product lines missing from the declaration: coffee powder, all confectionery, all savoury snacks, papads, pickles, masalas, ghee, merchandise. All product identifications above are from the company's own website catalogue (sweetkaramcoffee.in, /collections/all) — i.e. заявлено, не подтверждено: no customs line or shipping bill was reviewed in this task, so none of these codes is corroborated by an actual export record. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed per scope.
